description: Implement AirPlay, Picture-in-Picture, and background audio for iOS/tvOS. Add AirPlay integration for streaming to Apple TV/HomePod, Picture-in-Picture mode for iPad/iPhone (iOS 14+), background audio playback with AVAudioSession, Now Playing controls (Control Center/Lock Screen), integration with MPRemoteCommandCenter. Handle playback state restoration.
title: Phase 3.9: iOS/tvOS Media Features (AirPlay/PiP/Background)
